entries.proposition: ONLY MITOCHONDRIAL READOUT OF THE PAPER (T98G glioblastoma line, GAIN of WWOX): a resazurin-type dye conversion that is stated without a number, a p value or a panel, and its direction is HIGHER with WWOX. It is not oxygen consumption or complex I activity; NR-01 and NR-03 stay OPEN.
entries.snippet: A test with alamarBlue to assess mitochondrial metabolism revealed that cells overexpressing WWOX had a considerably higher rate of metabolizing the substrate, which may signify an intensification of overall mitochondrial redox potential.
entries.anchor: Results, Phenotype analysis of the WWOX transfectants, Proliferation, redox potential and apoptosis assays

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS' OWN EXPLANATION OF THE REDOX SIGNAL IS A TRANSCRIPT (DLD diaphorase), not respiration: the dye is reduced by dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase, whose mRNA is more than 3-fold up in the WWOX pool.
entries.snippet: The DLD expression in T98G/WWOX was >3-fold higher than that in the T98/vec control cells. This may explain the higher redox potential observed in the T98G/WWOX cells in the alamarBlue assay.
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph on the increase in mitochondrial redox activity

entries.proposition: TRANSCRIPTOME SCALE AND STATISTIC: 2,846 of about 29,000 genes pass an uncorrected t-test at p<0.05 (about 1,450 expected by chance alone at that threshold); the pathway table counts changed genes and gives no direction.
entries.snippet: A total of 2,846 genes showed a significant increase or decrease in expression depending on the WWOX level (p<0.05, t-test).
entries.anchor: Results, Transcriptome analysis of the WWOX transfectants

entries.proposition: THE ABSTRACT NAMES NOTCH AND HEDGEHOG AMONG THE MAIN PATHWAYS, BUT TABLE I (pathways with 10 or more modulated genes) LISTS ONLY WNT (38 genes) AND TGF-BETA (18 genes) OF THE FOUR; the words Notch and Hedgehog occur only in the abstract and the Discussion, never in a table.
entries.snippet: The cellular pathways containing 10 or more genes modulated by WWOX overexpression are presented in Table I.
entries.anchor: Results, Transcriptome analysis of the WWOX transfectants; Table I

entries.proposition: PATHWAY TABLE ROW: Wnt signalling is the largest named pathway with 38 modulated genes (direction not given, no beta-catenin or GSK3 readout in the paper). WO-22 stays OPEN.
entries.snippet: Inflammation mediated by chemokine and cytokine signaling pathway 39 Wnt signaling pathway 38
entries.anchor: Table I, rows 'Inflammation mediated by chemokine and cytokine signaling pathway' and 'Wnt signaling pathway'

entries.proposition: WESTERN BLOT CONFIRMATION IS OVERSTATED IN THE TEXT: the Discussion says the proteins were 'considerably lower'; no blot statistic is reported (the statistics section covers the biological assays) and Figure 4 as drawn shows overlapping error bars for all three.
entries.snippet: Western blot analysis confirmed that the level of these proteins was considerably lower in the cells with high WWOX expression (Fig. 4).
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph on cell cycle control and proliferation

entries.proposition: FIGURE 4 AS DRAWN (JAK1, KLF8, AURKA bars, three lanes per cell variant): JAK1 about 1.15 (vector) against about 0.97 (WWOX) with the error bars touching; KLF8 about 1.0 against about 0.55; AURKA about 0.62 against about 0.38; no asterisks or p values on any panel. Values read from the axes, approximate.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4 bars: JAK1 vec about 1.15 and WWOX about 0.97, KLF8 vec about 1.0 and WWOX about 0.55, AURKA vec about 0.62 and WWOX about 0.38, error bars overlap on all three panels, no significance marks. Values read from the axes, approximate.

entries.proposition: THE 3D-CULTURE CLAIM IS STRONGER THAN THE PANELS: the text says the WWOX cells remained isolated single cells at 12 days; the figure shows only day 4 and day 8.
entries.snippet: The cells seeded in a thick Geltrex® layer after 12 days remained as isolated, single cells that did not proliferate.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3 AS DRAWN: panels A and B are day 4 and C and D day 8 (caption), no day-12 panel. At day 8 the WWOX cells (panel D) show scattered clusters and fewer cells than the vector cells (panel C); they are not uniformly isolated single cells. One field per condition, no quantification.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3 panels A to D, day 4 and day 8 only; panel D (WWOX, day 8) shows scattered cell clusters and a lower density than panel C (vector, day 8), not isolated single cells; no day-12 image, no count.

entries.proposition: THE ABSTRACT'S 'INCREASED APOPTOSIS' AND 'INCREASED ABILITY FOR CROSSING THE BASEMENT MEMBRANE' ARE NOT SIGNIFICANT IN THE RESULTS (both p>0.05).
entries.snippet: T98G/WWOX cells demonstrated a slightly greater ability to cross a membrane coated with basement membrane matrix solution, with 29% more invasive cells. However, the result was not statistically significant (p>0.05).

entries.proposition: APOPTOSIS ROW OF THE SAME PARAGRAPH: increased 'although without statistical significance (p>0.05)'; the Conclusion nevertheless lists 'the increase in apoptosis' as evidence of lower malignancy.
entries.snippet: Simultaneously apoptosis was increased, although without statistical significance (p>0.05).
entries.anchor: Results, Proliferation, redox potential and apoptosis assays

entries.proposition: DESIGN: one WWOX construct, one pool of stable transfectants (not clones) against a vector pool; no clone-level replication, no rescue and no second cell line.
entries.snippet: A pool of stable transfectants was used for the microarray study of global gene expression and biological experiments.
entries.anchor: Materials and methods, Stable retroviral transfection

entries.proposition: EXPRESSION LEVEL OF THE MANIPULATION: mRNA more than 29-fold, protein about 4.8-fold (Figure 1 bars about 0.17 and 0.81), a strong overexpression far from a physiological dose.
entries.snippet: The amount of WWOX mRNA in the T98G/WWOX transfectants was >29-fold greater than that noted in the T98G/vec control cells.
entries.anchor: Results, Retroviral transfection and multiclonal selection allows for stable overexpression of the WWOX gene in T98G glioblastoma cells
